gloss: a party; a faction; a group

definitions.gloss: a party; a faction; a group
definitions.explanation: A group of people united by a common cause, goal, or allegiance. Often used in political contexts to refer to a political party or faction, and more broadly to any organized group or clique.

examples.japanese: {一党|いっとう}⟦{支配|しはい}→支配：01421_shihai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一党|いっとう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{反対派|はんたいは}→反対派：30532_hantaiha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抑|おさ}えた→抑える：12806_osaeru⟧。
{一党|いっとう}⟦{独裁|どくさい}→独裁：05969_dokusai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{体制|たいせい}→体制：04490_taisei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{民主主義|みんしゅしゅぎ}→民主主義：05413_minshushugi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{相容|あいい}れない。
examples.english: A one-party dictatorship is incompatible with democracy.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly encountered in the compound {一党|いっとう}⟦{支配|しはい}→支配：01421_shihai⟧ (one-party rule) or {一党|いっとう}⟦{独裁|どくさい}→独裁：05969_dokusai⟧ (one-party dictatorship). Can also refer to a group or gang in historical or literary contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一党|いっとう}⟦{支配|しはい}→支配：01421_shihai⟧ (one-party rule)
- {一党|いっとう}⟦{独裁|どくさい}→独裁：05969_dokusai⟧ (one-party dictatorship)
- {一党|いっとう}⟦{体制|たいせい}→体制：04490_taisei⟧ (single-party system)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{政党|せいとう}→政党：04338_seitou⟧: political party — a neutral term for a political party
- ⟦{派閥|はばつ}→派閥：16960_habatsu⟧: faction — a faction within a larger organization
